Scizor Defends (Japanese: ハッサム、受ける , Catch) is the 583rd chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 35th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Team Flare is revealed to have gone into hiding at Pokémon Village.
captures an .
The group comes across an unconscious that is guarded by a wild .
X attempts to capture the Pinsir, but fails due to a lack of skill in throwing Poké Balls.
X's group meets and learns that Diantha is safe.
Blue assists X in capturing the wild Pinsir and reveals the Scyther is unconscious due to its life energy being drained.
After battling Blue together, X convinces Pinsir to join his team until Scyther recovers from its condition.
receives a call from Professor Sycamore, who asks everyone to meet him in Anistar City.
